— Resources

Useful questions.
Better starting points.

Practical worksheets and guides for preparing a website project, reviewing marketing, and choosing your next priority.

Project preparation worksheet

Use these prompts before discussing a website or marketing engagement.

  • What does the business offer, and to whom?
  • What is the most important outcome?
  • What is the current website and platform?
  • Where are customers getting stuck?
  • What access and source material can be provided?
  • Who approves scope, content, and costs?
Download the worksheet ↓

Measurement review prompts

Start with definitions before asking for more dashboards.

  • What is a completed inquiry or purchase?
  • Does the real endpoint confirm it?
  • What happens when the action fails?
  • Are duplicate events prevented?
  • Are personal details kept out of tags?
  • Who rechecks the setup after site changes?
